GitHub `main` stays `064a4f0` (PR #28). `origin/develop` tooling (local live AWS, mock CI, pinned black/ruff) is not a live stack milestone; do not merge to `main` as parking. GitHub must not run live AWS.

README "What is live today" rewritten from that evidence. Staging and production named exercises were not re-proven this pass (`bot_idempotent` 400 on leftover ExerciseBot names against the v0.5.0 stacks).
